# Canonical rbt MCAP fixtures

These small files are generated only by the `rbt-mcap` implementation. They
exercise Image, PointCloud, ControlCommand, and globally interleaved playback.
Every schema comes from generated canonical `.rbt` IDL metadata.

Regenerate and immediately verify them with:

```bash
scripts/generate_mcap_fixtures.sh
```

The inputs use fixed metadata, channel order, log times, message headers, and
payload bit patterns. `mcap` currently stores some summary groups through hash
maps, so byte ordering is not promised across library implementations or
process hash seeds. Verification therefore checks semantic determinism: exact
schemas, channels, file-order messages, log times, and canonical payload bytes.

Large 1920x1080 Image and high-point-count PointCloud recordings belong under
`target/` and are generated by the full verification gate; they are not
checked in here. To generate the same three large cases manually:

```bash
cargo run --offline -p rbt-mcap --bin rbt-mcap-fixtures -- \
  generate-large target/mcap-large-fixtures
```

This creates one 6,220,800-byte Image payload, a 100,000-element PointCloud,
and a 1,310,720-element PointCloud whose element payload is exactly 20 MiB.
